# LLaDA NarrativeQA 10-sample end-to-end results

## Experiment definition

- Model: LLaDA2.1-mini, BF16, H800 PCIe.
- Exact input lengths: 8192, 16384, 24576, 32768 tokens.
- Requested generation lengths: 256, 512, 768 tokens, added on top of input.
- Modes: full-mask Dense, maskless Dense, Query, Prefix, Query+Prefix.
- Shared generation policy: seed 42; block length 32; steps 32; temperature 0; editing threshold 0; one-token transfer; EOS early stop disabled.
- Prefix configuration: Raw L1, budget 256, cost gates disabled.
- Ten NarrativeQA samples; one measured observation per sample and shape. Mode order rotates by sample; context order alternates. Fixed-shape warmups are excluded.
- gen=256 and gen=512 ran on GPU UUID 5116e707-63e1-5d46-e5cf-9732d39f793b; gen=768 ran on GPU UUID e1f1896c-2ef4-c506-381b-6ec7d068212f.

| Mode | Full attention mask | Query sparse | Prefix sparse |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Dense | yes | no | no |
| Maskless Dense | no | no | no |
| Query | no | yes | no |
| Prefix | no | no | yes |
| Query+Prefix | no | yes | yes |
